generate_sparse_data: generate random sparse tensor data with features, indices, and optional dense representation for spconv testing
params_grid: generate a cartesian product grid of all parameter combinations from multiple input parameter lists
assertAllEqual: assert two numpy arrays have exactly the same values with detailed mismatch reporting for test cases
assertAllClose: assert two numpy arrays or dicts of arrays have near values within relative and absolute tolerance
TestCase: extend unittest.TestCase with enhanced numpy array comparison methods including assertAllEqual and assertAllClose
